_comment: ruby#421 -- the engine-compat manifest. Every release train updates the pairings as it rides; tools/check_engine_compat.py verifies the manifest against the live registries in CI (tag <-> engine_commit, crates, npm, rubygems, pypi). Runtime versions follow the engine-linked scheme {engine-semver}.{runtime-single-digit} (npm: the engine semver, the 4th segment is invalid there) -- the leptris precedent. The 1.5.28 train: the retention-band diet (rs#736, rs#732/SOTA-2028/1 lever 1) -- the per-keystroke cache maintenance became O(fresh inserts): the post-parse retention compacts only the current parse's tail (the invariant: pre-parse survivors satisfy the keep predicate geometrically, no failure survives a parse end, pool-backed entries adopt at first retention; the one old entry the tail cannot skip -- root-at-start on input-length change -- became an explicit O(1) removal), the pre-parse shift prune merged three walks + two slot rebuilds into one pass + one rebuild, and no-drop passes skip the capacity-wide slot loops entirely. Interleaved A/B (same host minutes): doc0 incr p50 284 vs 390 us (-27%), doc3 2.198 vs 3.565 ms (-38%); identity 0 failures on both traces; memo fingerprints unchanged (doc0 reused 1,294,500 / doc3 11,051,417). Two new unit specs pin the tail invariants. npm 1.5.30 rides the 1.5.28-engine wasm (both tiers rebuilt via the candidate recipe; BUILT_FROM re-pinned at 4d7bb0f; the local suite 49/49 with the ts#110 engine-trap test green); the ruby ext lock rode 1.5.28 before the bump (ruby#568); py 1.5.28.0 vendors rs 4d7bb0f (py#83).
